--- title: "Week 12 - Update" author: "Victoria Sjalim" date: "2026-10-13" format: html execute: freeze: auto --- # Precision recall for GFA ::: {#413e7662 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd from collections import Counter import IS_dict as isd _, synonym_to_name = isd.build_synonym_dicts(isd.load_is_table()) def precision_recall(report_file, bed_file): # Predicted: one copy per locus; Truth: one copy per BED line loci = pd.read_csv(report_file, sep="\t").drop_duplicates("locus_id") pred_names = [n for t in loci["target"] for n in t.split(",")] truth_names = pd.read_csv(bed_file, sep="\t", header=None)[3] def clean(name): name = name.split("_")[0] # ISEc12_1 / ISEc12_IS21_unknown -> ISEc12 return synonym_to_name.get(name, name) # synonym -> canonical name pred = Counter(clean(n) for n in pred_names) truth = Counter(clean(n) for n in truth_names) rows = [] for count_copies in (True, False): p, t = (pred, truth) if count_copies else (Counter(set(pred)), Counter(set(truth))) names = set(p) | set(t) tp = sum(min(p[n], t[n]) for n in names) fp = sum(max(0, p[n] - t[n]) for n in names) fn = sum(max(0, t[n] - p[n]) for n in names) precision = tp / (tp + fp) recall = tp / (tp + fn) rows.append({ "Report": report_file.split("/")[-1].removesuffix("_report.tsv"), "Copies": "counted" if count_copies else "ignored", "TP": tp, "FP": fp, "FN": fn, "Precision": round(precision, 3), "Recall": round(recall, 3), "F1": round(2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), 3), }) return pd.DataFrame(rows) ``` ::: ::: {#9305cc55 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} bed = "../../data/ec958_IS.reannotated.sorted.bed" pd.concat([ precision_recall("../result/gfa_grill_me/gfa_grill_me_report.tsv", bed), precision_recall("../result/new_pipeline_block_gfa/new_pipeline_block_gfa_report.tsv", bed), ], ignore_index=True) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ## The mismatch ::: {#bdb8f14a .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} def mismatch_table(report_file, bed_file, count_copies=True): loci = pd.read_csv(report_file, sep="\t").drop_duplicates("locus_id") pred_names = [n for t in loci["target"] for n in t.split(",")] truth_names = pd.read_csv(bed_file, sep="\t", header=None)[3] def clean(name): name = name.split("_")[0] return synonym_to_name.get(name, name) pred = Counter(clean(n) for n in pred_names) truth = Counter(clean(n) for n in truth_names) if not count_copies: pred, truth = Counter(set(pred)), Counter(set(truth)) rows = [] for n in sorted(set(pred) | set(truth)): p, t = pred[n], truth[n] rows.append({"name": n, "pred": p, "truth": t, "TP": min(p, t), "FP": max(0, p - t), "FN": max(0, t - p)}) df = pd.DataFrame(rows) return df[(df.FP > 0) | (df.FN > 0)] bed = "../../data/ec958_IS.reannotated.sorted.bed" mismatch_table("../result/new_pipeline_block_gfa/new_pipeline_block_gfa_report.tsv", bed) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: # Further IS investigation - IS1A: IS not stitching -> didn't stitch together because name mismatches although they are synonyms - ISEc52: Half stitch/half not: The location might be to far away to stitch - ISEc49: it does match at least 83% identity, therefore, it was reported -> needs debugging for eris - ISSen1 & ISSen10: supposed to be IS629, re-labelling of the truth file # Re-checking the truth file ::: {#80556299 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} import mappy import pandas as pd GENOME = "../../data/EC958_chromosome.fasta" IS_DB = "../../data/IS_n.mmi" MIN_COVERAGE = 0.30 # same as eris --min-coverage; used only for the "in_bed" column MAX_GAP = 5000 # max bp between two pieces of the same interrupted IS WINDOW, STEP = 50000, 25000 db = mappy.Aligner(IS_DB) def overlaps(a, b): return a["start"] < b["end"] and b["start"] < a["end"] def remove_overlaps(hits): """Where hits overlap on the genome (window edges, competing IS), keep the best one.""" kept = [] for h in sorted(hits, key=lambda h: -h["matches"]): if not any(overlaps(h, k) for k in kept): kept.append(h) return kept def align_all(chrom_name, seq): """Align in overlapping windows; mask found hits with N and re-align, so pieces hidden behind a better hit of the same IS are also found.""" hits, masked = [], seq while True: new = [] for off in range(0, len(masked), STEP): for h in db.map(masked[off:off + WINDOW]): if h.is_primary: new.append({ "chrom": chrom_name, "start": off + h.q_st, "end": off + h.q_en, "target": h.ctg, "IS": h.ctg.split("_")[0], "strand": h.strand, "is_start": h.r_st, "is_end": h.r_en, "is_len": h.ctg_len, "matches": h.mlen, "aln_len": h.blen, }) new = [h for h in remove_overlaps(new) if not any(overlaps(h, k) for k in hits)] if not new: return sorted(hits, key=lambda h: h["start"]) hits += new for h in new: masked = masked[:h["start"]] + "N" * (h["end"] - h["start"]) + masked[h["end"]:] def stitch(hits): """Join pieces of the same IS (same name, same strand, continuing IS coordinates).""" copies = [] for h in hits: h = dict(h, pieces=1) prev = next((c for c in reversed(copies) if c["target"] == h["target"]), None) if prev and prev["strand"] == h["strand"] and h["start"] - prev["end"] <= MAX_GAP: # + strand: IS continues forward; - strand: the later genome piece is earlier in the IS continues = (abs(h["is_start"] - prev["is_end"]) <= 50 if h["strand"] == 1 else abs(prev["is_start"] - h["is_end"]) <= 50) if continues: prev.update(end=h["end"], is_start=min(prev["is_start"], h["is_start"]), is_end=max(prev["is_end"], h["is_end"]), matches=prev["matches"] + h["matches"], aln_len=prev["aln_len"] + h["aln_len"], pieces=prev["pieces"] + 1) continue copies.append(h) return copies rows = [] for chrom_name, seq, _ in mappy.fastx_read(GENOME): rows += stitch(align_all(chrom_name, seq)) all_is = pd.DataFrame(rows) all_is["identity"] = (all_is["matches"] / all_is["aln_len"]).round(3) all_is["coverage"] = ((all_is["is_end"] - all_is["is_start"]) / all_is["is_len"]).round(2) all_is["strand"] = all_is["strand"].map({1: "+", -1: "-"}) all_is["in_bed"] = all_is["coverage"] >= MIN_COVERAGE all_is = all_is[["chrom", "start", "end", "IS", "strand", "identity", "coverage", "pieces", "in_bed"]] all_is.index = range(1, len(all_is) + 1) # print(all_is.to_string()) ``` ::: ::: {#fb33af6b .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Copies per IS (repetitions), kept vs dropped all_is.groupby("IS")["in_bed"].agg(kept="sum", total="count").sort_values("total", ascending=False) # Save as a BED file (only if you want one; change the path first) # kept = all_is[all_is["in_bed"]].copy() # kept["name"] = kept["IS"] + "_" + (kept.groupby("IS").cumcount() + 1).astype(str) # kept["score"] = (kept["identity"] * 1000).astype(int) # kept[["chrom", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand", "identity", "coverage", "pieces"]] \ # .to_csv("../data/new_ec958_IS.realigned.bed", sep="\t", header=False, index=False) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}
